mood: Mysterious, ancient, tactile, premium, dark magic

rules: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for all major headings (H1-H3). Keep it elegant, using font-weight 600 or 700.
Use 'Spectral' for body text, card descriptions, and D&D stat blocks. It provides excellent legibility while maintaining a bookish, ancient feel.
Use 'Cinzel' for UI buttons, tabs, and overlines/labels (e.g., 'ARMOR CLASS', 'HIT POINTS'). Always uppercase.
Never use default generic sans-serif fonts like Inter or Roboto for main content to avoid breaking the immersion.
D&D stat blocks must strictly follow the traditional layout: bold labels followed by regular text, separated by thematic horizontal rules (often a tapered crimson or gold line).
typography.installation: Add Google Fonts link in public/index.html: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;600;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Spectral:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

colors.description: Obsidian black base with antique gold accents and crimson highlights.

textures: Tactile Noise Overlay: Add a subtle static noise overlay to the main background to simulate a matte, ancient grimoire cover. Use CSS mix-blend-mode or SVG filter.
Gold Foil: Use a subtle metallic CSS gradient for primary borders and key dividers (e.g., `bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-700 via-yellow-500 to-yellow-700`).
Parchment: For the actual trading cards, use a very dark warm grey (e.g., #151311) with a soft inner shadow to mimic thick cardstock.
surfaces: Solid, opaque surfaces. DO NOT use glassmorphism or transparent blur overlays; an ancient tome has solid, physical pages and covers.
Borders should be thin (1px) and colored in muted gold or dark brass (#44403c).

landing_auth: Hero layout with a central focus, large 'Cormorant Garamond' typography, and an atmospheric background image with a heavy vignette (`bg-black/60` to `bg-black/80` at the edges).
Auth forms should look like a dark, ornate plaque or page inside the tome, bordered with subtle gold.
collection_grid: Bento/Tetris grid pattern for the card collection dashboard. Cards displayed in a responsive grid (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`).
Gap: `gap-6` or `gap-8`. Cards should maintain a standard trading card aspect ratio (e.g., 2.5 : 3.5).
card_detail_flip: Split view: Left side displays the Card (interactive, flippable), right side contains the form controls (Shadcn customized) to edit stats.
The card must be wrapped in a Framer Motion 3D rotation container (`rotateY`).
The 'Front' contains Image, Name, Stats, Description, and QR Code.
The 'Back' contains the customized emblem, motto, and style.

motion.card_flip: Use framer-motion to create a realistic 3D card flip when a user clicks the 'Flip to Back/Front' button. Ensure `backface-visibility: hidden` is applied to the card faces.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements (cards in grid, buttons) should slightly lift (`-translate-y-1`) and cast a subtle gold or crimson shadow.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward drift (`translate-y-4` to `translate-y-0` and `opacity-0` to `opacity-100`) to feel deliberate and dramatic.

component_styles.buttons: Sharp corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). Primary buttons have a gold background with black text. Secondary buttons have a dark background with a 1px gold border and gold text.
component_styles.inputs_forms: Dark background (`bg-secondary`), bordered by `border-border`, white/parchment text. Focus ring should be the primary gold color.
component_styles.dnd_stat_block: A specific layout component matching D&D 5e visual hierarchy. A thick gold line at top/bottom, tapered red dividers inside, bold stat names (STR, DEX, etc.), and distinct blocks for actions/reactions.
component_styles.character_sheet: For the A4 PDF Character Sheet layout, use a dense, 2-to-3 column grid to fit Stats, Skills, Attacks, and Spell Slots cleanly. Use 'Spectral' for optimal printing clarity.

hero_background.description: An old, leather-bound book with textured pages. Use for landing page hero or auth background with heavy dark overlay.

empty_state_dashboard.description: An open spellbook with wand and quill. Use for 'No cards yet' or dashboard banner.

character_placeholder.description: Dark fantasy armor portrait. Use as a placeholder for Character Cards.

deck_placeholder.description: Black and gold box. Use as a placeholder for 'Decks' or card categories.

accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio is above 4.5:1 for the dark parchment text against the obsidian background.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="card-flip-button"`, `data-testid="generate-ai-content"`).
Add 'aria-hidden="true"' to decorative dividers and ornate border SVGs.
libraries: framer-motion (for card flipping and list stagger animations)
lucide-react (for icons, styled in antique gold)
html2canvas / jspdf (for Card sharing as image and PDF print front+back)
instructions_to_main_agent: Language is Italian by default. Ensure all static UI text is in Italian.
For Tailwind configuration, map the provided CSS variables to match the 'colors' palette exactly. No pure white or pure black backgrounds; everything should be tinted towards the grimoire theme.
Avoid the generic Shadcn 'card' look. Build custom HTML/Tailwind for the actual trading cards to achieve the trading card aspect ratio, inner borders, and layout.
In the Card Collection grid, use framer-motion to stagger the entrance of the cards.
For the card creation form, use Shadcn forms/inputs but restyle them with the dark background, sharp corners, and gold focus rings.

Ensure a toggle/button for 'Genera con AI' (Generate with AI) is prominently featured in the card creation forms, using a distinct visual style (e.g., a subtle gold pulse animation) to indicate magical generation.
The Character sheet view must be printable in A4 format. Use standard CSS print media queries (`@media print`) to hide UI controls and format the layout specifically for A4 paper dimensions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
